6.313 rsAggregateInDataRowSortExpression
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsAggregateInDataRowSortExpression is a critical error that will occur if an expression within
GaugePanel.SortExpressions, Chart.SortExpressions, or Tablix.SortExpressions uses an aggregate
function.
